# Other auxiliary tools

This directory organizes auxiliary tools commonly used in embodied AI experiments. The content here may not be related to robot algorithms themselves, but it affects environment configuration, model downloading, data processing, GPU operator performance, and daily development efficiency.

## High-speed Computing and Operator Library

- [FlashLib High-Speed Machine Learning Library](flashlib-high-speed-machine-learning-library.md): A classical ML operator library tailored for modern GPUs, covering KMeans, KNN, ANN, PCA, SVD, UMAP, t-SNE, HDBSCAN, GEMM, etc. It is suitable for large-scale embedding, trajectory features, and retrieval/cluster analysis.
- [flash-attn Quick Installation](flash-attn-quick-installation.md): Matches the FlashAttention wheel with PyTorch, CUDA, Python, and ABI, avoiding long compilation from source code.
